As a result of the last meeting and understanding and realizing that we had edited language in section B, I believe, under design and construction to standardize 5 to 12 age inclusive and 2 to 5 age inclusive playgrounds, we have also added in section A1 on lines 14 through 18 to add language to include both five to 12 year old and two to five year old

End of year funds, potentially grant money. We build a lot of playgrounds with proffer funding. So that's money that is managed and facilitated by LCPS. PTA, PTO, or outside funding is still acceptable to supplement a playground or to add a piece of equipment.

It's not typically building an entire playground, but we're just saying that this criteria will be utilized when any time we're managing the funding. Okay, I just wanted to make sure that that encompassed. Thank you. Any other questions or discussion?
